MCP Risk Inventory

Usage:
  mcp-risk scan [path-or-file ...] [--policy mcp-risk-policy.json] [--format text|json|markdown|sarif] [--output file] [--fail-on low|medium|high|critical|none]
  mcp-risk init [path-or-file ...] [--output mcp-risk-policy.json]

Examples:
  mcp-risk scan .
  mcp-risk scan . --format sarif --output mcp-risk-results.sarif --fail-on high
  mcp-risk init . --output mcp-risk-policy.json
